finding: A one-piece bare LTE modem/baseband IC seller listing exists; its price is not a complete cellular modem cost or a confirmed US voice design.

best_single_ic_listing.listed_part: Qualcomm MDM9207 (seller does not specify -0 or -1 silicon stepping)
best_single_ic_listing.type: Bare BGA modem/baseband IC, not a shielded cellular module or development board
best_single_ic_listing.seller: Tech-Electr, independent parts merchant (not established as a Qualcomm-authorized distributor)
best_single_ic_listing.availability_claim: Seller page says Stock Available and MOQ 1; actual inventory, provenance and fulfillment not independently tested.
best_single_ic_listing.voice_status: Qualcomm officially documents VoLTE for MDM9207-1. Seller's unqualified MDM9207 listing does not establish that its actual stepping, firmware image or US carrier provisioning supports VoLTE.
best_single_ic_listing.fit_status: Not a turnkey drop-in: chipset design and firmware access, RF design, antenna, power, SIM, carrier approval and certification required.

exact_voice_variant_leads.result: Exact VoLTE-documented -1 variant but cannot buy a single piece at published price.

One-piece marketplace listing for exact -1 part, but price is implausibly low, freight is negotiated and authenticity/firmware/condition are unverified. Do not treat as a usable engineering procurement quote.

other_checked_silicon.result: Not a one-chip purchase despite per-each price; exact part's VoLTE was not independently established from a Qualcomm primary specification.

other_checked_silicon.voice_status: UNISOC explicitly documents VoLTE for its bare 8910DM Cat1bis chip.
other_checked_silicon.price_status: No trustworthy exact one-piece public vendor price established; marketplace aggregation shows broad $0.99-$19.99 range, so no q1 price should be asserted.

other_checked_silicon.voice_status: ASR Micro brief specification says VoLTE supported and integrated RF transceiver, but retail q1 IC price and firmware access were not verified.

supporting_bom_evidence.document: Quectel EG95-NA module BOM filed with FCC, listing MDM9207-1 baseband alongside WTR2965 RF transceiver, PMD9607 power management, LTE PA, RF filters/switches, memory and crystal.

recommendation_for_table: Show $9.20 as an independently sold bare MDM9207 IC price, with a prominent exact--1-variant-not-confirmed and baseband-only caveat. For a working standalone US VoLTE/SMS design, use a documented module planning price until a complete chip-down RF/BOM, firmware license and carrier validation are available.
